title: Elia Kane
subtitle: Galactic Empire
description: Elia Kane seemed like a lowly bridge officer in service on Moff Gideon's light cruiser, but in time, she proved to be much more. Kane's allegiance to the Empire, and more specifically to Moff Gideon, was beyond compare. After Gideon's apprehension and subsequent disappearance, Kane remained in contact with the Moff, carrying out his will from inside the New Republic.
